_meta.description: Two fixes from the 7 October audit (openspec change review-audit-fixes-b). (1) A line item (leadProduct) is named after its product: OpenRegister resolves the product uuid in `objectNameField` to the product's name on save, so the Related widget on a lead lists 'Adviesuur' instead of an unnamed 'Lead Product'. Existing line items get their name on their next save. (2) The qualification score is calculated by `x-openregister-calculations` on every save, so the form must not offer it: `readOnly` keeps it out of the edit dialog, and the description says it is calculated. No property changes type and none becomes required.

qualificationScore.description: Calculated when the lead is saved, from its value, client, contact, source, close date, priority and description. You cannot change it by hand.
qualificationScore.x-notes: Materialised by the x-openregister-calculations.qualificationScore annotation on every save; never written by service code or the form. readOnly keeps it out of the edit dialog (fieldsFromSchema skips readOnly properties), because the backend overwrote any value typed there.
